# DiffPal

> DiffPal is open-source AI pull request review that runs in your CI, lets teams bring their own provider or ACP-compatible agent, and publishes consistent findings, summaries, artifacts, and merge gates across supported code hosts.

## Start Here

- [Home](/): Product overview and core outcomes.
- [Docs](/docs): Main documentation index.
- [GitHub Quickstart](/getting-started/github-quickstart): Fastest path to a first DiffPal review.
- [Getting Started](/getting-started/): Choose a code host, provider, and feedback mode.

## Core Concepts

- [How DiffPal Works](/concepts/how-diffpal-works): Review workflow and system boundaries.
- [Review Lifecycle](/concepts/review-lifecycle): Stages from scope resolution through publishing and gates.
- [Providers And Agents](/concepts/providers-and-agents): Provider, agent, CI, and code host responsibilities.
- [Findings, Feedback, And Gates](/concepts/findings-feedback-and-gates): Finding taxonomy, publish surfaces, and blocking policy.
- [Comparison Guide](/concepts/comparison): When DiffPal fits compared with hosted reviewers and other tools.

## Integrations

- [Integrations](/integrations/): Shared CI and code host setup guidance.
- [GitHub Actions](/integrations/github-actions): Run DiffPal in GitHub Actions.
- [GitLab CI](/integrations/gitlab-ci): Run DiffPal in GitLab merge request pipelines.
- [Azure Pipelines](/integrations/azure-pipelines): Run DiffPal in Azure Pipelines pull request validation.
- [Custom CI/CD](/integrations/custom-ci): Run DiffPal outside the native host wrappers.

## Providers

- [Providers](/providers/): Choose and configure a review provider.
- [Codex Provider](/providers/codex): Use Codex through the default onboarding path.
- [Copilot Provider](/providers/copilot): Use Copilot with a supported token in CI.
- [OpenCode Provider](/providers/opencode): Use OpenCode as an ACP provider.
- [Custom ACP-Compatible CLI](/providers/custom-acp): Connect another ACP stdio server.
